records.name: Easy Progressive Build and Upright Rhythm Run — Teaching Proposal

exactProposedMechanics.start: Still comfortable bilateral standing start with relaxed natural arms and a known straight route. No rolling, three-point, falling or reactive start is added.
exactProposedMechanics.build: Build smoothly over 0–10 m: easy context about 2/10 toward 3/10; independently qualified modest-intent context about 2/10 toward 4/10. No maximal start or forced early upright posture.
exactProposedMechanics.rhythm: Retain relaxed selected effort over 10–20 m: about 3/10 easy or 4/10 in the qualified context. Natural coordinated running and arms; no fly threshold, timed result or maximal second half.
exactProposedMechanics.runoff: Reduce speed gradually through 20–35 m. Do not force an abrupt stop at 35 m or shorten runoff for the clock. If actual effort no longer fits the retained protected route, hold/reduce, explicitly reconfigure or defer.
exactProposedMechanics.exitReturn: Exit by the declared protected path, then use the separate one-way outside return and full recovery. Return turns and staging are logistics, not extra technical or cutting repetitions.
exactProposedMechanics.contactRule: Count every attempt, including partial/faulted work. Record actual build/rhythm/runoff/exit/return, intended/reported effort, contacts, distance, time and response. Zero prescribed jump-drill repetitions is not zero cyclic running flight, contacts or impact; actual contact totals remain null until observed.

geometry.boundary: Retains OR04 planning geometry, not OR07 diagonal fan; short5+10m P2/acceleration remains a separate task. Saved OR08 releases/traffic compared locally; actual facility and operating fit remain unverified.
geometry.geometryRule: Inspect actual return/staging distances and unforced walking time; no metres inferred from timers. Stationary athletes stay in visible personal bays in the assigned slot. If corridor and bay cannot both be observed from a safe coach position, omit/defer that combination. No coach shadows35m and rushes back.

preparationContext.P1: Retain OR04 basic no-flight in-place rhythm or independently eligible quiet standing; no travel/high-knee/skip upgrade.
preparationContext.P2: Retain actual short still-standing 5 m easy initiation plus 10 m runout only when independently eligible; otherwise its walking/stationary task. No new intent or full-route running credit.
preparationContext.E0: Count full selected-corridor walking orientation and dedicated return. Walking does not prove jogging/slowing. No full-route walk is hidden in short P2.
preparationContext.firstRun: First whole easy run or first qualified modest-intent attempt occurs in counted E1; no extra athlete trial/test.
preparationContext.outlineReconciliation: Active OR08 amendment explicitly keeps40s P1/140s independent short P2; whole-route E0 and first intent instruction are counted in main. P2 changes no intent and grants no long-running permission.

retainedStrengthContext.familiarTwoDBGate: Actual most recent compatible TWO-dumbbell record at the same pair/load/range/count with independently controlled pickup, top start, hinge repetitions and set-down, plus suitable current response. A single first OR06 loaded lesson or attendance does not establish familiarity. Actual OR07 unloading or a newer smaller record is not silently reversed; absent OR07 is not fictitious unloading history.

DB.setup: Five individually fitting elevated pickup/parking stations with TEN simultaneously suitable DBs at actual retained pairs/loads. One DB in each hand, palms facing inward, long arms and tall top stand with weights near thighs. Soft knees and organized trunk; move hips back with the DBs close through the actual owned hamstring-limited range. No floor-touch target or new range/handling test.
DB.nextRowReuse: Only after all hip work is parked/cleared during later row setup; actual suitable loads still required.
DB.sourceVsAuthorContext: Source331 verifies dumbbell-standard-tempo with TWO dumbbells on close independent paths and declared owned hamstring-limited range; related legacy RDL instructions explain hip-height start, soft knees, keeping load close and stopping before spinal compensation rather than reaching the floor. Palms-in/long-arm wording, fitting elevated pickup, handling clock and this small dose are explicitly declared OR08 session context, not a newly verified mandatory source profile.
